name: grain
description: Query your databases from Codex with read-only safe mode on by default, and see every query the agent runs.

interface.shortDescription: Safe SQL for agents, on your machine
interface.longDescription: Grain connects Codex to DuckDB, Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, Trino and more. Queries run read-only by default, credentials stay on your machine, and every query the agent runs is visible in the Grain workspace.
defaultPrompt: Use Grain to list my database connections
Use Grain to show the tables in my warehouse and describe the largest one
